sectors.trend: Positive; multiple WA exploration successes (Dalaroo Cu-Ni-PGE, Jupiter/Critica rare earths 58% carbonate, Augustus 30g/t gold, Auric Burbanks) signal a resource super-cycle in WA. Gold grades at Aguia (Colombia) also record.
sectors.implications: Supports BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX sentiment; small-cap miners (JUP.AX, CRX.AX, AUG.AX, AUC.AX) attract speculative flows. Rare earths theme gains policy tailwind.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced on easing yields, but structural headwinds: state interest costs soaring, private credit risk, Bathla insolvency contagion, and IMF fiscal warning.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from yield curve easing short-term; credit cycle risk (Bathla, private credit) warrants caution on NAB.AX and WBC.AX exposure.

sectors.trend: Mixed; Middle East oil shock risk and east-coast fuel supply crunch create volatility. Coal-fired power debate (Qld data centre) adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: SAP.AX, WDS.AX, AGL.AX, CGP.AX face policy risk; fuel distributors under pressure. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) benefit from oil price support.

sectors.trend: ResMed upgraded; Anthropic $31bn Qld datacentre deal signals tech infrastructure buildout. AI adoption in media (News Corp) accelerates.
sectors.implications: RMD.AX positive catalyst. Data centre build supports WES.AX, SGP.AX (power demand). CSL.AX steady.

sectors.trend: Cue and Veronika Maine near collapse; tenants see rent relief; ACCC targets real estate monopoly. Real wages crushed by exploited workers.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary weak; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) may benefit from ACCC intervention and rent moderation. WES.AX, WOW.AX under pressure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / fuel supply crunch
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor A$ fuel distributor inventory; favour LNG exporters (WDS.AX) over domestic refiners
Reduce AUD-sensitive importers; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) that benefit from weaker AUD
Review bank credit exposure; avoid high-yield private credit; monitor NAB.AX, WBC.AX loan books

risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour rate-sensitive REITs cautiously; avoid over-leveraged property; monitor ^AORD
Monitor construction and hospitality sectors; WES.AX, SGP.AX may face cost pressures

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA small-cap miners on exploration success
opportunities.rationale: Dalaroo Cu-Ni-PGE, Jupiter/Critica rare earths, Augustus gold, Auric Burbanks create a pipeline of catalysts; weak AUD boosts A$ revenue
RMD.AX upgrade signals improving healthcare device demand; defensive quality in volatile tape

opportunities.recommendation: Position for Qld data centre / power demand buildout
opportunities.rationale: Anthropic $31bn deal and coal-power debate create multi-year capex cycle for utilities and infrastructure

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to fuel distributors and import-heavy consumer names
defensive_moves.rationale: East-coast fuel supply crunch and Middle East oil shock risk; Cue/Veronika Maine collapse signals consumer fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with export-oriented miners
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD crushed post-Fed; BHP, RIO, FMG benefit from commodity pricing in USD

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid over-leveraged credit and private credit exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla insolvency storm and private credit risk to rich-listers; state interest costs rising

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with upside bias into Fed decision; oil volatility and AUD weakness create two-way risk. Banks support index; miners offset consumer weakness. Watch ^AXJO for 1-2% upside if oil stabilises.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining pipeline, data centre capex, and ACCC pro-competition reforms. Headwinds from RBA rate path, state fiscal stress, and immigration-driven labour constraints. 6-12 month view cautiously constructive for ^AORD if oil shock resolves.
